title: SWAP5 Solver Interface, HeadCalc Isolation & Hydraulic Process Boundary v1 100% Completeness, Current-Canonical Closure & Final Qualification Audit

production_dependency_inspection.method: Exact-current source-bound semantic inspection plus authority reconstruction. Default-branch code search was not accepted as authoritative negative evidence for a non-default canonical ref.

production_dependency_inspection.conclusion: A universal no-hit proof is unnecessary for the completion decision because a reachable production-interface violation is positively proven. The positive violation alone triggers the frozen hard gate.

hard_blockers: Reachable direct HeadCalc production calls remain outside soil_water_solver_t.
Standalone SWAP bypasses the common solver boundary because no worker is supplied.
The worker production Task2 adapter is conditional and falls back to direct HeadCalc for non-admitted configurations.
Therefore production transaction/diagnostic/alternative-solver semantics are not universal across all soil-water execution routes.
Standalone and serialized MultiSWAP do not yet share one mandatory solver-service seam.

closure_gaps.minimal_remediation: Route every production SoilWater task-2 execution, including standalone and all frozen-v1 configurations, through one typed soil-water solver service. Remove direct HeadCalc calls from MOD_SoilWater; HeadCalc may remain callable only behind mod_reference_richards_legacy_binding or an equivalent solver-internal adapter.
